```{python}
#| label: generar-figuras-suplementarias
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "lancet"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis, show_table
import pandas as pd

# Figures S2–S5 and S7–S9 are rebuilt here, at render time, from docs/lancet/data; S1 and S6 are static plates inherited from revision 09.
started = time.time()
build = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "figuras_suplementarias.py"], cwd=ROOT / "docs" / "lancet", capture_output=True, text=True)
if build.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(build.stderr[-3000:])
qa = pd.DataFrame(json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "lancet" / "qa" / "figuras_suplementarias_qa.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
qa_view = qa.assign(figure=qa.figure.str.replace("_", " ", regex=False), **{"Off-canvas texts": qa.out_of_canvas.map(len), "Overlaps": qa.overlaps.map(len),
                       "Font sizes (pt)": qa.font_sizes_pt.map(lambda s: f"{min(s)}–{max(s)}")})
counts = rh.summary_counts("supplement", "en")
kpis([
    (str(len(qa) // 2), f"Supplementary figures regenerated by this page in {time.time() - started:.0f} s (plus S1 and S6, inherited)"),
    (str(counts["equations"]), "Numbered equations of the extended methods (STIX images from equations_lancet.py)"),
    (str(counts["tables"]), "Supplementary table parts (S1 to S9)"),
    (str(counts["references"]), "Supplementary references"),
])
```

The supplement opens with the extended methods (sections A1 to A11) and continues with the complementary results, the tables and the figures, in the same order as the submitted document (`supplement_en.docx`). The text and tables come from `docs/lancet/data/contenido_v10.json`; the equations are the images composed with the STIX family that the document prints, at a single type size. Figures S2–S5 and S7–S9 are rebuilt at every render by `docs/lancet/figuras_suplementarias.py` from `docs/lancet/data/`; figures S1 (data flow) and S6 (territorial maps) are plates inherited from revision 09. In figure S7 and in figure 4d of the article, the commune comparison uses `communes_public.csv`, an extract without identifiers in which cells with 1 to 4 records are masked variable by variable, so that the points shown coincide with those of the manuscript; the sensitivity to the count threshold (S7d) is read precomputed on the complete commune file, which is not published.

```{python}
#| label: control-figuras-suplementarias
show_table(qa_view[["figure", "language", "width_mm", "height_mm", "Font sizes (pt)", "Off-canvas texts", "Overlaps"]].rename(columns={
    "figure": "Figure", "language": "Language", "width_mm": "Width (mm)", "height_mm": "Height (mm)"}),
    "Layout check of the plates generated in this render (text outside the canvas and overlaps between labels must be zero)",
    {"Width (mm)": 1, "Height (mm)": 1})
```
